title: A prose hymn of homage to various portions of the Atharva-vada classed according to the number of verses which their hymns contain

verses.t: Hail to the four-verse strophes of the Atharvanas!
Hail to the single non-Rich-versed ones!
Hail to the two Sūryā hymns!
Hail to the two Vrātya hymns!
Hail to the two Prajāpati hymns!
Hail to the hymn of victory!
Hail to the hymns for happiness!
Collected manly powers are topped by Brahma. Brahma at first spread out the loftiest heaven. Brahma was born first of all things existing. Who then is fit to be this Brahma's rival?
